notes: DCA 6-2015 Table 3A (p. 6), Dimension Lumber Deck Beam Spans (L_B), under the Connecticut 2022 pack. Each hand-authored expectation was read from the page (PDF sha256 205d57b5...3009e), not exported from the pack: the per-row cases were written from the PDF's text layer (pdftotext -layout, p. 6), while the pack's rows were typed from the page rendered at 300 dpi, so this file cross-checks the two readings. Per row one span case: the joist span inside the column's band (6': 5'-0"; 8': 8'-0"; 10': 9'-9"; 12': 11'-6"; 14': 14'-0"; 16': 14'-1"; 18': 17'-0") and the beam span 1" under L_B (6'), at it (8', 18'), 2" over (10'), 1/2" under (12'), 1" over (14') or 3" under (16'); the second group's rows cycle through its seven species. A two-name cell ('3x8 or 2-2x8') is two rows with the same expected L_B. Then the note's worked example (beam span post centre to post centre), a case per guide scope limit, the inputs the scope and table ask for, and the column refusals. The generated cases are GoldenRunner.DeckBoundaries' output, committed.
